why: The one-pip fallback stops carrying the stock-loss cue: four players at four or five stocks on a phone lose a stock and nothing swells or bursts, because the single pip is the only element the cue could animate -- the defect #838 rejected the bare digit for. A teams entry reaches this branch at exactly those two cells (issue #1055 measured that it needs the fallback there, keeping its letter), so the teams cases pin it beside the FFA one; the pip is also the element `.hud--reduced-motion .hud-stock-pip.hud-stock-cue` reaches, so the reduced-motion form loses its target with it.
